sources.name: First Wave Colonist Beret (F)
sources.description:
This Imperial commendation was given to all first wave colonists to mark the five year anniversary of the Calypso colony. After the Robot wars Calypso was repopulated by intrepid colonists, pioneers, and adventure-seekers. These were times of great battles, historical events and massive turning points, all shadowed by the push to establish a new home for mankind. Over half a million colonists set foot on Calypsian soil during the endeavor. Some perished and others succeeded beyond their wildest dreams. Business, societies, friendship and collaboration flourished as humans once again took a firm grasp of the alien world.

The First Wave began arriving at 23:53, in the year 2003, local time. This commendation is a mark of respect for the sacrifices, challenges, anger and passion, the colonists endured during these initial five years.
